memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech. - Gen 4:18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At first glance this is just a list of hard-to-pronounce names - the sort of verse we are tempted to skip. But even a genealogy tells a story. This is the line of Cain, generation after generation, moving further from Eden. The names roll on, and still God is not mentioned, not called upon, not worshipped. It is a family tree growing away from its Maker.

Genealogies remind us of a sobering truth: faith is not inherited automatically. Cain's descendants carried on his family name and his distance from God. What we pass to our children is not only our features and our fortunes, but often the direction of our hearts.

Yet God, in recording even these names, shows that no life is beneath His notice. He keeps track of every generation. And running quietly alongside this line, Scripture will soon introduce another line - Seth's - where people "began to call on the name of the Lord" (Gen 4:26).

Two family lines, two directions. The question for each of us is which direction we are travelling, and which we are passing on. In Christ, anyone can start a new line of faith today (2 Tim 1:5).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What spiritual direction are you passing to those who follow you?
- Are you drifting further from God, or drawing near?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, let the line that flows from my life move toward You, not away. Help me pass on a living faith to those who come after me.
